title: Word Break
summary: Decide whether the entire string can be split into consecutive dictionary words.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–300 lowercase letters in s. The dictionary has 1–1000 distinct lowercase words of lengths 1–20.

statement: Decide whether the entire string can be split into consecutive dictionary words. A word may be used any number of times.

examples.explanation: Choosing ab leaves the dictionary word cd.

constraints: 1–300 lowercase letters in s. The dictionary has 1–1000 distinct lowercase words of lengths 1–20.
hints: Conceptual: A matching prefix is useful only if the rest can also be split.
Directional: Track which boundaries are reachable from the beginning.
Implementation: From each reachable boundary, mark the end of every dictionary word that matches there.
complexityAnalysis: O(n × D × L) time and O(n) extra space for direct matching. D is dictionary size and L is the longest word length.
